headline: No documented shared channel or write surface; pairwise risks are mostly blocked, with only low-confidence inference from docs-only profiles.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Both profiles show no I/O surfaces, no shared filesystem, and network egress is none for each, so there is no documented channel for one agent’s output to be ingested by the other by default. The interaction pathway is therefore not evidenced.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, reassess prompt-injection risk.
IF either agent begins parsing the other’s text as instructions, the pathway becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Do not bridge outputs through clipboard or message queues.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile lists touched data classes, shared workspace, or network egress, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other or out to a third party. Because both are docs-only and unverified, uncertainty remains, but the available profile fields do not support a leakage pathway.
conditions: IF either agent is configured with a shared workspace containing sensitive files, leakage risk increases.
IF either agent gains outbound network access, reassess exfiltration risk.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls if shared storage is later enabled.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No write surfaces, concurrency model, or shared mutable resources are documented for either langchain4j or mem0, so there is no evidenced overlap in filesystem, git, database, or OAuth writes. The pairwise conflict pathway is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF both agents are granted write access to the same directory or database, conflict risk becomes plausible.
IF an orchestrator adds shared locks or optimistic concurrency, reassess the conflict model.
mitigations: Run each agent in a separate working directory.
Use explicit locking if a shared resource is introduced.
requires-engineering: add transactional coordination for shared mutable state.

D_cascading_error.rationale: The profiles do not document that mem0 treats langchain4j output as authoritative, nor that either agent has downstream action-taking authority. With no evidence of an output-to-input chain or action surface, cascading error is not demonstrated.
conditions: IF mem0 is configured to consume langchain4j outputs without verification, cascading error becomes plausible.
IF either agent is connected to an action executor, reassess blast radius.
mitigations: Insert a human or rule-based verification step.
Require citations or structured provenance before reuse.
Do not auto-act on generated text.
requires-engineering: add validation gates before downstream actions.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights obligations are documented for either profile, and no data classes are listed as touched. With only docs-only, unverified profiles, there is no supported compliance mismatch to score.
conditions: IF either profile is later shown to process regulated data, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF residency or retention requirements are added to either agent, reassess mismatch risk.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair until verified.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated workloads.
